setup:
adduser --quiet --disabled-password --comment 'Site deploys' deploy && install -d -o deploy -g deploy /var/www/ana.example && printf ' ana.example

Hello from ana.example

' > /var/www/ana.example/index.html && chown deploy:deploy /var/www/ana.example/index.html
printf '192.0.2.10 ana.example   # stand-in for public DNS: ana.example is a documentation name\n' >> /etc/hosts

printf '

About

\n' > /var/www/ana.example/about.html && chown deploy:deploy /var/www/ana.example/about.html && for i in $(seq 9); do curl -s -o /dev/null -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) Firefox/140.0' http://ana.example/; done && for i in $(seq 4); do curl -s -o /dev/null -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh) Safari/605.1.15' http://ana.example/about.html; done && for p in /wp-login.php /.env /admin /wp-login.php /.git/config; do curl -s -o /dev/null -A 'Mozilla/5.0 zgrab/0.x' http://ana.example$p; done && for p in /robots.txt / /about.html; do curl -s -o /dev/null -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Googlebot/2.1)' http://ana.example$p; done && for i in $(seq 3); do curl -s -o /dev/null -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) Firefox/140.0' http://ana.example/; done
